interpretation_notes: The supplied original yaw grid +/-0.4 can clip the paper Figure 6 region; boundary contacts are reported.
Requested middle steering angle is 3 degrees; published Figure 6 uses 3.5 degrees.
Speed-domain exclusions u<0.5 m/s are not nonfinite numerical failures and are not automatically published oversteer/sideslip/rollover failures.
Dynamic longitudinal speed, tire coefficients, sprung mass, roll-arm parameters, finite horizon, and discrete vertex selection contain stated reconstruction assumptions.
Zero sampled unstable points inside the polytope does not prove continuous or asymptotic stability.
